description: Configure, view, or remove webhook for watchlist event notifications. Events: watchlist.company_changed, watchlist.financials_updated, watchlist.company_removed_from_registry.

action.description: Action: 'get' to view config, 'set' to configure, 'delete' to remove.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to. Defaults to all available events.

url.description: HTTPS webhook endpoint URL (required for action=set).

name: set_webhook_url
title: Configure Webhook URL
